frobenius_convention.sign_warning: there is no extra (-1)^w in the local-system trace; the minus sign is already in Tr(U_D)=-a_D/sqrt(q)

groupoid_equivalence.full_affine_nonsquare_coset: not an F_q marked-curve isomorphism; it exchanges a marked curve with its nontrivial quadratic twist

odd_central_weight.exact_result: a fixed nonsquare affine change is a bijection of H5(q), sends U_D to -U_D up to conjugacy, and therefore forces the total model sum and marked-stack Frobenius trace to be zero when w is odd
odd_central_weight.scope_firewall: this is cancellation of the total trace across quadratic twists; it does not assert that each curve trace vanishes

resource_contract.arithmetic: integers and fractions only; no floats

scope.base_fields: every finite field F_q of odd characteristic
scope.moduli_groupoid: smooth genus-two curves over F_q with one marked F_q-rational Weierstrass point

trace_theorem.meaning_of_stack_trace: sum over F_q-isomorphism classes of marked curves of the fibre Frobenius trace divided by |Aut_q|; by the stack trace formula, this is the alternating compactly-supported cohomological trace
